rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound indicating number of petals
adjective indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What name, petal count, and structure characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is designated as royal.
The sixth cakra has eight petals.
The sixth cakra possesses a central pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled center with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact referent of rājānam as a proper name or descriptive epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
